subtitles.en: Interest rates have moved away from the effective lower bound, driven in part by structural pressures that includes, in particular, in this part of the world, rising defence spending.
subtitles.zh: 利率已脱离有效下限，部分原因是结构性压力，特别是在欧洲，国防开支上升。

subtitles.en: And the shocks of this era are more likely to fall on the supply side than on the demand side.
subtitles.zh: 这个时代的冲击更可能来自供给侧而非需求侧。

subtitles.en: Because these negative supply shocks have tended to push prices upwards, interest rates have moved away from the effective lower bound.
subtitles.zh: 由于负面供给冲击推高价格，利率已脱离有效下限。

subtitles.en: gaming town. I don't think we've heard that so often recently, and I hope we don't.
subtitles.zh: 最近我不常听到这种说法，希望以后也不会。
